brief: Trial NCT02406508 (Delcath Systems, phase 2). What happened to it, how many people enrolled, and does it owe results?

findings.claim: Trial NCT02406508 (Delcath Systems, Phase 2) status is WITHDRAWN.
The stated why_stopped text for NCT02406508 is "No enrollment in the study", categorized under enrollment.
NCT02406508 start date is October 2014, primary completion date is December 2017, and completion date is December 2017.
NCT02406508 does not owe results because it never enrolled patients.
findings.notes: Withdrawn trials that never enrolled do not post results.

tool_calls.name: query_trials_sql

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, t.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late, t.sponsor FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT02406508'
